blocks.tamil_translation: when it comes towards the head, the head will say, “You have no way to come towards me, because this man used to recite “Surah al-Mulk'.” “Surah al-Mulk” prevents the punishment of the grave, says Hazrat Ibn Mas'ud (RA). In the Tawrah its name is “Surah al-Mulk'. Whoever recites this surah on any one night has earned a great deal of reward,” says Hazrat Ibn Mas'ud (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرََ ﵄ يَقُوْلُ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ سَرَّهُ اَنْ يَنْظُرَ اِلي يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ كَأَنَّهُ رَأْيُ عَيْنٍ فَلْيَقْرَأْ:۞)اِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ۞) وَ (اِذَا السَّمَآءُ انْفَطَرَتْ۞) وَ (اِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ۞).
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال هذا حديث حسن غريب، باب ومن سورة «اذا الشمس كورت».رقم:٣٣٣٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever wishes to see the scene of the Day of Qiyamah as if seeing it with his own eyes, let him recite “Surah Idhash-shamsu kuwwirat', “Surah Idhas-sama'un fatarat', “Surah Idhas-sama'un shaqqat',” Hazrat Ibn Umar (RA) reports that the Prophet ﷺ said.(Because the details of the Day of Judgement are described in these surahs).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اِذَا زُلْزِلَتْ تَعْدِلُ نِصْفَ الْقُرْآنِ، وَقُلْ هُوَ اللهُ اَحَدٌ تَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ، وَقُلْ يَآيُّهَا الْكفِرُوْنَ تَعْدِلُ رُبْعَ الْقُرْآنِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال : هذا حديث غريب، باب ما جاء في اذا زلزلت، رقم:٢٨٩٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “Surah “Idha zulzilatil ard' is equal to half of the Qur'an, Surah “Qul huwallahu ahad' is equal to one third of the Qur'an, Surah “Qul ya ayyuhal kafirun' is equal to one quarter of the Qur'an,” Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) reports that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The noble Qur'an speaks about man's life in this world and in the Hereafter. Also
